items.docs:
This endpoint allows merchants to create products within ShipMonk. Once created, product data is immutable via API — updates must be made via the ShipMonk web app. SKUs must be unique within the account. ShipMonk will reject non-unique SKUs with a 400 error.

The required_packaging field defines the minimum packaging suitable for a product. When fulfilling an order, ShipMonk selects the smallest packaging type that satisfies every item in the shipment — for example, if an order contains one prod

Search for products based on a set of filters and sorting criteria. A cursor is returned that can be used by /integrations/products/search/paginate endpoint to iterate through the results.

The search results are fixed at the time of the request. This guarantees that it's possible to iterate over the whole data set reliably without missing any products.
The returned cursor is valid for 1 hour.

info.name: Fetch results from Products for Inventory Sync

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor returned from the initial /integrations/products/search call, or the next_cursor value returned from a previous call to this endpoint.

items.docs:
Iterate over results from /integrations/products/search endpoint using the returned cursor or using the cursor provided by response of this request as nextCursor.

The response is the same as the legacy /products endpoint (Retrieve List of Products).

params.name: search
params.description: Free-text filter matched against product SKU, name, or barcode.

params.name: page
params.description: 1-based page number to return. Defaults to 1.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of products returned per page (default and maximum values are documented at the endpoint level).

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Field to sort the results by; one of 'id', 'created_at', or 'updated_at'.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort direction for the results: ASC (ascending) or DESC (descending). Defaults to DESC.

params.name: status
params.description: Return only products in this status (e.g., active, blacklisted, disabled). See the enum schema for the full list of allowed values.

params.name: dateUpdatedStart
params.description: Return only products updated at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: dateUpdatedEnd
params.description: Return only products updated at or before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: dateCreatedStart
params.description: Return only products created at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

params.name: dateCreatedEnd
params.description: Return only products created at or before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

items.docs: Results are not guaranteed to be consistent across paginated calls. As inventory is updated during fulfillment, products shift position in the sort order and may reappear on later pages. For consistent pagination, use the Products for Inventory Sync endpoint instead.
